action.rationale: Fresh start on a 10D deterministic problem with total budget 100 and no incumbent or active method yet. Per principle 1, spending ~12% (~12 evals) on probes will characterize modality/curvature and seed the archive before committing.

Probes show a wide landscape (log10_range=5.812) yet some funnel structure (fdc_spearman=0.552), and top-10 are not clearly clustered (top10_spread_vs_uniform=1.018), so it’s ambiguous which global method will progress faster. A small race between CMA-ES and TuRBO in 10D, deterministic setting (88 evals left) will identify the better workhorse while preserving most budget.

CMA-ES won the race with 32271.98 vs TuRBO’s 32415.7 after only 15 evals, and the active CMA-ES hasn’t run outside the race yet (evals_in_tenure=0, sigma=2.69, not converged). With 58 evaluations left and no convergence/exhaustion flags, continuing CMA-ES is the highest-payoff next step.

Only 8 evals remain and CMA-ES has stalled for 32 evals with popsize=10, so continuing it is inefficient. The problem is deterministic and our incumbent is 13271.7, making a local derivative-free polish (BOBYQA) from the incumbent the best use of the remaining budget.
